task.title: L8a.2: secure Vulkan backend-pack import into an app-managed, versioned runtime folder
task.objective: Phase L L8a.2 (awkit-djnl.11). A Settings workflow that imports the pinned Vulkan backend pack (AI_BACKEND_MANIFEST, node-llama-cpp@3.21.1+llama.cpp@v0.4.0) from a user-selected folder into %LOCALAPPDATA%/SpecterStudio/ai/backends: a preflight checklist (backend, build, source, destination, required size, free space with headroom, identical-pack detection, files validated, a local-copy warning and explicit confirmation), validation against the built-in manifest cross-checked with the Ed25519-signed dependency manifest (paths, sizes, SHA-256, build and backend identity, no traversal, no reparse point or alias outside the selected root, no unexpected executable or native payload, never loading native code from the source), a staged copy hashed while written, the application's own signed-manifest-verified Visual C++ runtime copied beside the backend (never from the pack), revalidation of the staging, atomic promotion into a new versioned directory, idempotent re-import, rollback that preserves the previous valid pack, and safe cleanup of staging after cancellation, failure or restart. Registration persists only the app-managed directory name and status. A reusable load-time integrity guard refuses a missing, altered, extra or replaced file, marks the pack invalid with a concise reason, never repairs or executes it, and leaves CPU inference available. No GPU loading, layer offload, device selection, CUDA, model registration or L8a.3 behavior.

security: No new permission: every backend-pack channel is gated on AI_MANAGE in main, and each mutation re-authenticates.
Native code in a selected folder is only read and hashed, never loaded, executed or probed.
The Visual C++ runtime beside the backend comes only from the application's own tree, verified against the Ed25519-signed dependency manifest.
offline: No download, internet access, admin right, global Node or runtime, driver installation or source compilation.
Nothing is written into resources or app.asar; every write stays under the app-managed backends folder.

acceptance.description: Validation, staged copy, VC++ runtime sourcing, revalidation, atomic promotion, idempotence, rollback, cancellation and restart recovery, path confinement and the load-time integrity guard behave as specified, with mutation checks on hash validation, path confinement, staged revalidation and the load-time guard.
The Settings workflow imports, verifies, reports tampering and removes the pack in the real Electron app with accessible controls and no claim that a GPU is active.
Typecheck, bundles, script typecheck, verifier registry and the unchanged packaged runtime pass.
